name: OIL AND GAS DEVELOPMENT COMPANY LIMITED

announcements.headline: First quarterly report September 30, 2026
announcements.insight: OGDC released its first quarterly results following the annual report and AGM. This update follows the commencement of production from Bitrism East-1.

announcements.headline: 1st Quarter Results
announcements.insight: OGDC reports first quarter results following its June 2026 annual financials. This periodic update provides continuity for shareholders tracking recent operational developments.

announcements.headline: COMMENCEMENT PRODUCTION FROM BITRISM EAST-1
announcements.insight: Production commencement from Bitrism East-1 marks a key operational milestone. This follows the transfer of BESOS shares back to the Govt. of Pakistan in July.

announcements.headline: Resolutions- 29th AGM held on October 16, 2026
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM resolutions following the June 2026 financial results. This confirms standard governance procedures rather than strategic changes.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: OGDCL publishes annual results for June 30, 2026, following Bobi Deep-1 production and BESOS share transfers.

announcements.headline: Financial Results for the year ended June 30, 2026
announcements.insight: OGDCL reports annual financial results. This follows recent production starts from Sahito-1 and Bobi Deep-1, and the final interest payment receipt.

announcements.headline: NOTICE: UNCLAIMED SHARES AND DIVIDENDS
announcements.insight: Shareholders should check if their shares or dividends are unclaimed. This is an administrative notice unrelated to recent production or transaction updates.

announcements.headline: Transfer of BESOS shares back to Govt. of Pakistan
announcements.insight: OGDCL transfers BESOS shares to the Govt. of Pakistan, following its recent operational milestones in Sindh. This divestment alters its asset portfolio but lacks financial detail.

announcements.headline: OGDCL Brings Bobi Deep-1 into Production
announcements.insight: Bobi Deep-1 enters production following the June discovery. This operational milestone advances the project timeline established earlier in the year.

announcements.headline: RECEIPT OF 12TH AND FINAL INTEREST PAYMENT BY PHL
announcements.insight: OGDC receives its final interest payment. This follows earlier announcements regarding an oil discovery, a farm-in transaction completion, and the commencement of gas production.

announcements.headline: Commencement of Gas Production from Sahito-1
announcements.insight: Gas production has commenced from Sahito-1. This follows the June farm-in completion, indicating progression of that transaction.

announcements.headline: COMPLETION OF FARM-IN TRANSACTION IN QADIRPUR D&PL
announcements.insight: OGDC completes a farm-in transaction in Qadirpur D&PL. This follows the June oil discovery from Bobi Deep 1, indicating progression of development activities.

announcements.headline: Oil Discovery from Bobi Deep 1 Dist. Sanghar Sindh
announcements.insight: An oil discovery from Bobi Deep 1 in Sanghar Sindh suggests potential resource growth. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent exploration or appraisal results.
